---
name: Spec Feedback
about: Provide feedback on the specification or propose a change
title: "[Spec] "
labels: spec-feedback
assignees: ''
---

## Which section of the spec?

Identify the specific part of DRF or CRF you are addressing (e.g., "DRF synthesis section", "CRF relationship types").

## Format

- [ ] DRF (Decision Reasoning Format)
- [ ] CRF (Context Reasoning Format)
- [ ] Both / Integration

## Type of Feedback

- [ ] Clarification needed (the spec is unclear)
- [ ] Proposed change (I think something should work differently)
- [ ] Missing capability (the spec does not cover a needed scenario)
- [ ] Backward compatibility concern

## Current Behavior / Text

What does the spec currently say or how does it currently work?

## Proposed Change

What should change, and why? Be as specific as possible.

## Impact Assessment

- Does this break existing documents? (yes / no / unsure)
- Which fields or sections are affected?
- Would existing examples need updating?

## Real-World Scenario

Describe a concrete use case where this change matters.

## Additional Context

References, related issues, or prior discussions.
